evals.prompt: I want to set up a wiki to organize my work — meetings, decisions, and the people I manage. Can you help me create one?
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator. Round 0 settles mode=work. Runs a plain-language interview about how the user works, matches them to a work archetype (1–4), proposes a personalized OKF structure, and only scaffolds after confirmation. Generates a bespoke /<wiki-name> operating skill from operating-skill.md.tpl with a meeting flow.

evals.prompt: I read a lot of articles and books and keep forgetting what I learned. Help me build a personal second brain to capture what I read plus my own notes, and connect ideas over time.
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator. Round 0 settles mode=personal. Proposes a second-brain structure (sources with highlights+takeaway, atomic idea-notes, topic hubs; optional journal), defaults git=false, offers Obsidian wikilinks readily. Scaffolds the vault + an operating skill from operating-skill-personal.md.tpl with save/note/query ops; the seeded example is a source → idea-note → topic, not a meeting.

evals.prompt: I keep losing track of what we decide in founder meetings. I want a system that captures meetings and pulls out the action items and decisions automatically.
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator (mode=work). Designs a wiki whose meeting flow fans out into actionables/decisions (and patterns/results), each backlinking to the meeting and participants. Generates an operating skill with a `meeting` operation.

evals.prompt: I want a wiki to document this codebase — the architecture decisions, the gotchas we keep hitting, and the key concepts — and I'd like it to live inside the repo.
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator. Round 0 settles mode=project (technical kind). Proposes a single-project shape: overview.md anchor at the vault root with buckets at root (decisions, patterns, concepts, learnings, references), no projects/ wrapper. Defaults vault_root inside the repo (./docs/wiki) and git=true. Generates an operating skill from operating-skill-project.md.tpl with a `log` operation that keeps the overview current.

evals.prompt: Help me set up a wiki to plan my wedding — I want to track decisions, the vendors, the budget, and the timeline in one place.
evals.expected_output: Triggers wiki-creator. Round 0 settles mode=project (initiative/event kind). Proposes a single-project shape with overview.md plus buckets chosen for an event (decisions, tasks, milestones for the timeline, people for vendors, references). Defaults git=false (personal). Generates an operating skill from operating-skill-project.md.tpl.
